runic_descriptions.name: Artificial Death
runic_descriptions.simple_description: The death awakens after taken attack.

runic_descriptions.name: 狮鹫骑士
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 给予周围友军护盾与荆棘。

runic_descriptions.name: 光明龙
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 给予再生与其他正面效果。

runic_descriptions.name: 冥界侍从
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 给予虚弱与其他负面效果。

runic_descriptions.name: 暗言师/毁灭者
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 换形师，变为毁灭者形态时能造成巨额伤害。

runic_descriptions.name: 该隐
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 受到治疗时获得采矿效果。

runic_descriptions.name: 头狼
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 给予周围友军集中效果。

runic_descriptions.name: 风烟元素
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 减缓元素活性的衰减速率。

runic_descriptions.name: 告死天使
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 对随机敌人造成百分比伤害。

runic_descriptions.name: Lenora&The Submarine
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 使敌人时间倒流，回到出生点。

runic_descriptions.name: Tidal Caller
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 能加快所有符灵师能力的冷却。

runic_descriptions.name: Boulder Elemental
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 攻击速度较慢，能击退敌人。

runic_descriptions.name: Dark Elemental
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 使敌人受到逐渐提升的伤害。

runic_descriptions.name: Hound
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 给予敌人流血，使其受到伤害提升。

runic_descriptions.name: Spirit Smith
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 增幅前方和后方的友军。

runic_descriptions.name: Ragefire Elemental
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 攻击能燃烧敌人，并在攻击燃烧敌人时爆炸。

runic_descriptions.name: Necromancer
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 给予敌人诅咒，使其死后为己方而战。

runic_descriptions.name: LaserWalker
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 击杀敌人时获得采矿效果。

runic_descriptions.name: Engineer
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 每波结束后获得采矿效果。

runic_descriptions.name: Serpant
runic_descriptions.simple_description: 具有额外的攻击力和攻击速度。

skills_descriptions.name: 长剑
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 提升攻击力
skills_descriptions.full_description: + !X! %攻击力

skills_descriptions.name: 圆盾
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 提升生命值
skills_descriptions.full_description: + !X! %生命值

skills_descriptions.name: 战斧
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 大幅提升攻击力
skills_descriptions.full_description: + !X! %攻击力

skills_descriptions.name: 神圣护盾
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 提升防御力与生命值
skills_descriptions.full_description:
+ !X! %防御力 
+ !Y! %生命值

skills_descriptions.name: 追月者
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 提升攻击力与射程
skills_descriptions.full_description:
+ !X! %攻击力 
+ !Y! 攻击范围

skills_descriptions.name: 笔锋
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 提升攻击力。每3次攻击造成双倍伤害。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
+ !X! %攻击力。
每3次攻击造成双倍伤害。

skills_descriptions.name: 火炬
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 使攻击给予敌人燃烧。
skills_descriptions.full_description: 攻击会给予敌人 !X! 加上 !D! %攻击力的燃烧。

skills_descriptions.name: 死亡苏醒
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 被动：提升大量攻击力。受到伤害时能获得集中。拥有集中时才能进行攻击。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
被动：提升 !X! %攻击力。受到伤害时获得 !Y! 层集中。拥有集中时才能进行攻击。
集中：攻击伤害增加50%。每有1层集中，额外提升1%。每次触发，层数-1。

skills_descriptions.name: 魔法光环
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 使周围的友方符灵获得护盾和荆棘。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
使周围的友方符灵获得自身攻击力 !D! %的护盾和荆棘。
护盾：抵消将要到来的伤害。
荆棘：受到伤害时，使敌人失去等同于层数的生命。每次发动层数减半。

skills_descriptions.name: 天国
skills_descriptions.simple_description:
被动：每当你给予友方符灵一种正面效果，再随机给予一种（不能循环叠加）。
主动：进行一次爆炸攻击，给予周围的友方治疗与护盾。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
被动：每当你给予友方符灵一种正面效果，再随机给予一种（不能循环叠加）。
主动：进行一次爆炸攻击，给予友方 !D! %攻击力的治疗与护盾。
护盾：抵消将要到来的伤害。

skills_descriptions.name: 极恶诅咒
skills_descriptions.simple_description:
被动：每当你给予敌人一种负面效果，再随机给予一种（不能循环叠加）。
主动：进行一次爆炸攻击，给予敌人虚弱。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
被动：每当你给予敌人一种负面效果，再随机给予一种（不能循环叠加）。
主动：进行一次爆炸攻击，给予敌人 !X! 层虚弱。灵魂契约：与易伤。
灵魂契约：如果生命值大于50%，失去10%生命值来发动效果。
虚弱：攻击伤害降低25%。每有1层虚弱，额外降低1%。每次触发，层数-1。
易伤：受到伤害增加50%。每有1层易伤，额外提升1%。每次触发，层数-1。

skills_descriptions.name: 能量转换
skills_descriptions.simple_description:
晶体印记：暗言师形态攻击时获得晶体印记。
毁灭之眼：在毁灭者形态时，每有1层毁灭之眼，攻击伤害提升100%。
主动：从暗言师形态变身为毁灭者形态，将所有晶体印记变为毁灭之眼。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
晶体印记：暗言师形态攻击时获得一层晶体印记。
毁灭之眼：在毁灭者形态时，每有1层毁灭之眼，攻击伤害提升100%。
主动：从暗言师形态变身为毁灭者形态 !X! 秒，将所有晶体印记变为毁灭之眼。

skills_descriptions.name: 鲜血祭祀
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 被动：每当该符灵获得治疗，触发微量采矿效果。
skills_descriptions.full_description: 被动：每当该符灵获得治疗，触发 !X! %采矿效果。(满生命值时也能触发)

skills_descriptions.name: 嗥叫
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 使周围的友方符灵获得集中，提升它们的攻击伤害。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
使周围的友方符灵获得 !X! 层集中。
集中：攻击伤害增加50%。每有1层集中，额外提升1%。每次触发，层数-1。

skills_descriptions.name: 封印太阳
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 吟唱数秒然后爆炸攻击周围区域。期间每获得1点法力都会提升爆炸半径与伤害。
skills_descriptions.full_description: 吟唱 !X! 秒然后爆炸攻击周围区域，造成 !D! %攻击力的伤害。期间每获得1点法力都会提升爆炸半径与伤害。

skills_descriptions.name: 高空哨塔
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 被动：哨塔投弹手具有永久的无实体。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
被动：哨塔投弹手具有永久的无实体。
无实体：不能被攻击，也不能阻拦敌人。

skills_descriptions.name: 光落万丈
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 被动：攻击时会使敌人获得失明，具有失明的敌人攻击只能造成1点伤害，然后其对失明免疫。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
被动：攻击时会使敌人获得 !X! 层失明与失明免疫。
60层元素活性：追加1层失明。
200层元素活性：追加1层失明。
750层元素活性：追加2层失明。
失明：攻击只能造成1点伤害。每次触发，层数-1。

skills_descriptions.name: 流星雨
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 召唤流星雨攻击数个随机敌人。
skills_descriptions.full_description: 召唤流星雨攻击战场上的 !X! 个随机敌人，对每个敌人造成 !D! %攻击力的伤害。

skills_descriptions.name: 火焰吐息
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 朝前方喷出一个大火球，伤害、燃烧与击退所有击中的敌人。
skills_descriptions.full_description: 朝前方喷出一个大火球，对所有击中的敌人造成 !D! %攻击力的伤害、伤害数值 !X! %层数的燃烧以及弱击退。

skills_descriptions.name: 风烟渐染
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 被动：减缓元素活性的衰减速度。
skills_descriptions.full_description: 被动：元素活性的衰减量减少 !X! %。

skills_descriptions.name: 寂灭
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 随机惩戒一个敌人，对其造成波生命值百分比的伤害。
skills_descriptions.full_description: 随机惩戒一个敌人，对其造成波生命值 !X! %的伤害。

skills_descriptions.name: 微光粉尘
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 给予一片区域的敌人中毒。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
给予一个敌人和其周围的敌人 !D! %攻击力的中毒。
中毒：每秒受到中毒层数的伤害。

skills_descriptions.name: 不灭存在
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 获得永恒层数。永恒能减免99%受到的伤害。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
获得 !X! 层永恒。
永恒：减免99%受到的伤害，每次发动其层数-1。

skills_descriptions.name: 弑君
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 被动：BOSS出现时，对其造成大量伤害。
skills_descriptions.full_description: 被动：BOSS出现时，对其造成 !D! %攻击力的伤害。

skills_descriptions.name: 星界躯体
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 获得吸收层数。吸收能使受到的伤害降低至最大生命值的10%。
skills_descriptions.full_description: 获得 !X! 层吸收。吸收能使受到的伤害降低至最大生命值的10%。

skills_descriptions.name: The stopwatch
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Passive: attacks has a chance to teleport the enemies back to the spawn point.
skills_descriptions.full_description: Passive: attacks has a !X! %chance to teleport the enemies back to the spawn point.

skills_descriptions.name: 唤潮
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 使用时降低所有能力的冷却。
skills_descriptions.full_description: 使所有能力的冷却时间降低 !X! 秒。

skills_descriptions.name: 元素汇聚
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 被动：所有友军法力回复加快。达到一定元素活性时进一步提升此效果。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
被动：每秒为所有友军恢复 !X! 法力值。
200层元素活性：追加0.5法力值恢复。

skills_descriptions.name: 旋风斩
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 斩击周围的区域，对所有敌人造成伤害与易伤。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
斩击周围的区域，对所有敌人造成 !D! %攻击力伤害与 !X! 层易伤。
易伤：受到伤害增加50%。每有1层易伤，额外提升1%。每次触发，层数-1。

skills_descriptions.name: 巨石投掷
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 被动：攻击速度减慢，攻击会给予敌人弱击退。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
被动：攻击速度修正 !X! 。攻击会给予敌人力量为 !Y! 的弱击退。
60层元素活性：追加1力量。
200层元素活性：追加1力量。
750层元素活性：变为强击退。

skills_descriptions.name: 黑夜统治
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 被动：攻击使敌人获得黑暗沁染。这会提升其之后受到的伤害。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
被动：攻击使敌人获得 !X! 层黑暗沁染。
60层元素活性：追加1层黑暗沁染。
200层元素活性：追加1层黑暗沁染。
750层元素活性：给予的黑暗沁染，其总层数翻倍。
黑暗沁染：每有1层黑暗沁染，受到伤害增加1%。不会消除。

skills_descriptions.name: 爪击
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 爪击屏幕上的数个敌人。
skills_descriptions.full_description: 爪击屏幕上的 !X! 个随机敌人，造成 !D! %攻击力伤害。

skills_descriptions.name: 撕咬
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 撕咬一个敌人，使其受到伤害并获得流血。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
撕咬小范围的敌人，使其受到 !D! %攻击力的伤害并获得 !X! %攻击力的流血。
流血：每有1层流血，受到的伤害提升1。

skills_descriptions.name: 灵魂锻造
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 被动：前一格的友军获得防御力提升。后一格的友军获得攻击力与射程提升。
skills_descriptions.full_description: 被动：前一格的友军提升 !X! %防御力。后一格的友军提升 !X! %攻击力与射程。

skills_descriptions.name: 寒霜射击
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 被动：攻击会使敌人获得冰冷。冰冷会减少敌人的移动速度与攻击速度。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
被动：攻击会使敌人获得 !X! 层冰冷。
60层元素活性：追加3层冰冷。
200层元素活性：追加4层冰冷。
750层元素活性：追加5层冰冷。
冰冷：每有1层冰冷，行动速度降低1%。每秒层数-1。

skills_descriptions.name: 恩典
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 大幅治疗一名友方符灵，并使其获得相同层数的再生。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
为一名友方符灵恢复 !D! %攻击力的生命值，并使其获得相同层数的再生。
再生：每秒恢复再生层数的生命，然后层数减半。

skills_descriptions.name: 烈火燃烧
skills_descriptions.simple_description: 被动：敌人生成时对其发射火球弹，使其受到持续伤害。对已经被燃烧的目标必定触发爆炸攻击。
skills_descriptions.full_description:
被动：敌人生成时对其发射火球弹，使其获得 !D! %攻击力的燃烧。对已经被燃烧的目标必定触发爆炸攻击。
60层元素活性：火球弹追加20%攻击力的燃烧。
200层元素活性：火球弹追加20%攻击力的燃烧。
750层元素活性：普通攻击也会附带火球弹1/3的燃烧。
燃烧：每秒受到等同于层数的伤害。每次发动其数值减半。

skills_descriptions.name: web building
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Passive: when enemy was spawned, chance to launch a spider web to it, dealing damage and applying stun, weak and volunerable. Granteed to trigger against bosses.
skills_descriptions.full_description:
Passive: on enemy spawn there is !Y! % chance to launch a spider web to it, dealing !D! %attack damage and !X! stun, weak and volunerable. Granteed to trigger against bosses.
stun: units with stun are incapable of any actions. Stacks -1 every second.
weak：addack damage reduced by 25%。For each weak stack, reduce an additional 1%. Stacks -1 for each trigger.
volunerable：damage taken increased by 50%。For each volunerable stack, increases an additional 1%. Stacks -1 for each trigger.

skills_descriptions.name: Death Curse
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Passive: attacks curses the enemies, has a chance to enslave them after they died.
skills_descriptions.full_description:
Passive: attacks curses the enemies, applying !X! enslave. 
enslave：after death, each enslave stack adds 1% chance for the enemy to become a friendly unit.

skills_descriptions.name: Breathe of Destruction
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Passive: attacks are granteed to attach explosiveattacks.
skills_descriptions.full_description: Passive: attacks are granteed to attach explosiveattacks with range of !X!.

skills_descriptions.name: Light Chisel
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Passive: trigger a few mining effects on killing enemies.
skills_descriptions.full_description: Passive: trigger !X! % mining effects on killing enemies.

skills_descriptions.name: Chain Lightning
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Passive: attacks are granteed to attach bounceattacks.
skills_descriptions.full_description:
Passive: attacks are granteed to attach !X! bounceattacks. 
60 Elemental Activity：+1 Additional bounces.
200 Elemental Activity：+1 Additional bounces.
750 Elemental Activity：+2 Additional bounces.

skills_descriptions.name: Bone Shot
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Shoot a lot of scattering targetless arrows.
skills_descriptions.full_description: Shoot !X! scattering targetless arrows, each dealing !D! % attack damage.

skills_descriptions.name: Blessing
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Passive: regenerate health each second for all allies.
skills_descriptions.full_description: Passive: regenerate health equal to !X! plus !H! % health each second for all allies.

skills_descriptions.name: Shell
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Passive: Gain damage reduction while below half health.
skills_descriptions.full_description: Passive: Gain !X! %damage reduction while below half health.

skills_descriptions.name: The Masterwork
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Passive: trigger mining effects on end of each wave.
skills_descriptions.full_description: Passive: trigger !X! % mining effects on end of each wave.

skills_descriptions.name: Deft
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Passive: Increase attack damage and attack speed.
skills_descriptions.full_description: Passive: Increase !X! attack damage and !Y! attack speed.

skills_descriptions.name: Skeleton Summoning
skills_descriptions.simple_description: summon skeletion(s) on the enemy half.
skills_descriptions.full_description:
summon !X! skeletion(s) on the enemy half, each has !D! % attack and health. Soul Pact: summon 1 more.
Soul Pact: lose 10% health to trigger if health higher than 50%.

skills_descriptions.name: Rapid Shot
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Shoot an arrow to enemy quickly.
skills_descriptions.full_description: Shoot an arrow to enemy quickly, deals !D! % damage.

skills_descriptions.name: Moon Befall
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Passive: attacks are granteed to attach multiattacks.
skills_descriptions.full_description: Passive: attacks attach !X! multiattacks.

skills_descriptions.name: Heavy Strike
skills_descriptions.simple_description: Deal Massive damage to an enemy and stuns them.
skills_descriptions.full_description:
Deal !D! % damage to an enemy and apply !X! stun. 
stun: units with stun are incapable of any actions. Stacks -1 every second.

kinds_descriptions.name: Warrior
kinds_descriptions.simple_description: Have !AMOUNT! different runics of that kind, to gain them !X! and !Y! % extra armor.

kinds_descriptions.name: Warlock
kinds_descriptions.simple_description: Have !AMOUNT! different runics of that kind, enables them to heal !X! health on dealt damage.

kinds_descriptions.name: Priest
kinds_descriptions.simple_description: Priests' attacks turns into healing to allies in range if they are healable. Have !AMOUNT! different runics of that kind, allowing you to overheal to a max to !X! times max HP.

kinds_descriptions.name: Marksman
kinds_descriptions.simple_description: Have !AMOUNT! different runics of that kind, to gain them !Y! % attack damage and !X! attack range。

kinds_descriptions.name: Mage
kinds_descriptions.simple_description: Have !AMOUNT! different runics of that kind, lets your runics reduce !X! mana cost while casting active abilities.

kinds_descriptions.name: Knight
kinds_descriptions.simple_description: Have !AMOUNT! different runics of that kind, to gain them !X! % damage reduction.

kinds_descriptions.name: Judger
kinds_descriptions.simple_description: Have !AMOUNT! different runics of that kind, to gain your runics !X! bonus health.

kinds_descriptions.name: 匠
kinds_descriptions.simple_description: Have !AMOUNT! different runics of that kind, to gain your runics !X! attack speed, and also allows you to merge !Y! -star-[craftmen] to higher star by 2 copies.

kinds_descriptions.name: 刺客

kinds_descriptions.name: Elemental
kinds_descriptions.simple_description: 元素反应：元素的技能皆为被动技能，但元素仍能获得法力值并能以20点法力值施放技能：获得20点元素活性。元素活性可以增强元素的被动技能。集齐 !AMOUNT! 种不同的该种族的符灵以使获得的元素活性 * !X! 。

kinds_descriptions.name: Human

kinds_descriptions.name: Mech

kinds_descriptions.name: Ocean

kinds_descriptions.name: Transcendence
kinds_descriptions.simple_description: 神话：只有一种该种族符灵时使其飞升，其攻击力、生命值与护甲变为 !X! 倍。

kinds_descriptions.name: Undead
kinds_descriptions.simple_description: 疯狂：集齐 !AMOUNT! 种不同的该种族的符灵以以使它们获得 !X! %速度。速度会提升大多数属性值。

ability_descriptions.name: Spacial Curse
ability_descriptions.simple_description:
使阴影缠绕每个敌人，造成你DPS !Y! %的伤害与 !X! 层易伤。
冷却时间 !CD! 秒。
易伤：受到伤害增加50%。每有1层易伤，额外提升1%。每次触发，层数-1。

ability_descriptions.name: Tidal Call
ability_descriptions.simple_description:
召唤巨大的潮汐席卷整个战场，造成你DPS !X! %的伤害与强击退。
冷却时间 !CD! 秒。

ability_descriptions.name: Golden Finger
ability_descriptions.simple_description:
将一名随机敌人转化为黄金。其立即死亡，获得 !X! 倍$与灵魂。
冷却时间 !CD! 秒。

ability_descriptions.name: Bird of Prry
ability_descriptions.simple_description:
召唤 !Y! 只游荡在战场上的猛禽，打击附近的敌人，每次造成你DPS !X! %的伤害。
每次攻击冷却时间 !CD! 秒。

ability_descriptions.name: Golden Board
ability_descriptions.simple_description:
将战场变为金色 !Y! 秒。期间击杀的敌人掉落的$与灵魂变为 !X! 倍。
冷却时间 !CD! 秒。

ability_descriptions.name: Battle Front
ability_descriptions.simple_description:
战线在最前方承受所有敌人的攻击，其受到攻击会消耗城防值。
 主动：为战线补充城防值，其数值为你DPS的 !X! %。多次获取的城防值可以叠加，但是获取量会衰减。
冷却时间 !CD! 秒。
